heading: INT. MARS TRANSIT STATION, MAINTENANCE BAY - SOL 412

units.text: INT. MARS TRANSIT STATION, MAINTENANCE BAY - SOL 412
A low gray room lit by rack lights.
A rover on a cradle, its wheel hub stripped.
Tools laid out on a magnetic table.
Dust on every surface, the red fine-grained dust that gets everywhere.
TECH ADAEZE CHUKWUDI-VANCE (30s) is on her back under the rover.
Her boots stick out.
Across the bay, DR. CASIMIR NAKASHIMA-BRIGGS (50s) taps at a console.
A stranger stands in the airlock hatch: a man in a dusty suit, helmet under one arm, a clipboard in his other hand.
Cas, hand me the 10-mil.
units.name: ADAEZE

units.text: Which one's the 10?
units.name: CASIMIR

units.text: The one that isn't the 12.
units.name: ADAEZE

units.text: The stranger steps forward.
Excuse me. I'm looking for the station supervisor.
units.name: SURVEYOR

units.text: Adaeze rolls out.
Casimir turns.
That would be me. And you are?
units.name: CASIMIR

units.text: Colin Maddox-Reyes. Surveyor, Earth Authority.
units.name: SURVEYOR

units.text: Surveyor, huh? You came a long way for a clipboard.
units.name: ADAEZE

units.text: It's a good clipboard.
units.name: COLIN

units.text: The intercom crackles.
Station, Orbiter. We've got an inbound dust front. Thirty minutes.
units.name: ORBITER

units.text: Copy, Orbiter.
units.name: CASIMIR

units.text: Colin, you picked a lovely day.
units.name: ADAEZE

units.text: Just my luck, Adaeze.
units.name: COLIN

units.text: I didn't tell you my name.
units.name: ADAEZE

units.text: Colin's smile does not change.
The clipboard clatters to the floor.
His other hand comes up holding a very small, very precise pistol.
